title: In silico and structural investigation of sulfonamides targeting VraSR two component system in methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus.
authors: Verma, Abhishek Kumar; Srivastava, Sandeep Kumar
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过虚拟筛选和分子模拟寻找靶向MRSA VraSR双组分系统的磺胺类抑制剂，虽涉及VraR-DNA结合域，但核心是药物发现而非TF-DNA互作机制建模，方法为对接和简单模拟，深度不足。
abstract: Drug-resistant Staphylococcus aureus strains are global health concerns. Several studies have shown that these strains can develop defences against cell wall antibiotics such as beta-lactams, glycopeptides and daptomycin which target cell wall biosynthesis. The coordination of these responses have been associated with two component system (TCS) regulated by histidine kinase protein (VraS) and its cognate regulator VraR which influences the target DNA upon signal recognition. Computer-based screening methods, predictions and simulations have emerged as more efficient and quick ways to identify promising new compound leads from large databases against emerging drug targets thus allowing prediction of small select set of molecules for further validations. These combined approaches conserve valuable time and resources. Due to methicillin resistance, sulfonamide-derivative medications have been found to be effective treatment strategy to treat S. aureus infections. The current study used ligand-based virtual screening (LBVS) to identify powerful sulfonamide derivative inhibitors from an antibacterial compound library against VraSR signaling components, VraS and VraR. We identified promising sulfonamide derivative [compound 5: (4-[(1-[(3,5-Dimethoxyphenyl)Carbamoyl]Methyl-2,4-Dioxo-1,2,3,4-Tetrahydroquinazolin-3-Yl)Methyl]-N-[(Furan-2-Yl)Methyl]Benzamide)] with reasonable binding parameters of -31.38 kJ/mol and DeltaG(bind) score of -294.32 kJ/mol against ATP binding domain of sensor kinase VraS. We further identified four compounds N1 (PCID83276726), N3 (PCID83276757), N9 (PCID3672584), and N10 (PCID20900589) against VraR DNA binding domain (VraR(C)) with DeltaG(bind) energies of -190.27, -237.54, -165.21, and -190.88 kJ/mol, respectively. Structural and simulation analyses further suggest their stable interactions with DNA interacting residues and potential to disrupt DNA binding domain dimerization; therefore, it is prudent to further investigate and characterize them as VraR dimer disruptors and inhibit other promoter binding site. Interestingly, the discovery of drugs that target VraS and VraR may open new therapeutic avenues for drug-resistant S. aureus. These predictions based on screening, simulations and binding affinities against VraSR components hold promise for opening novel therapeutic avenues against drug-resistant S. aureus and present opportunities for repositioning efforts. These efforts aim to create analogs with enhanced potency and selectivity against two-component signaling systems that significantly contribute to virulence in MRSA or VRSA. These analyses contribute valuable insights into potential avenues for combating antibiotic-resistant S. aureus through computationally driven drug discovery strategies.
abstract_zh: 耐药性金黄色葡萄球菌菌株是全球性的健康问题。多项研究表明，这些菌株能够发展出针对细胞壁抗生素（如β-内酰胺类、糖肽类和达托霉素）的防御机制，这些抗生素靶向细胞壁生物合成。这些反应的协调与双组分系统（two component system, TCS）相关，该系统由组氨酸激酶蛋白（VraS）及其同源调节因子VraR调控，后者在信号识别时影响靶DNA。基于计算机的筛选方法、预测和模拟已成为从大型数据库中识别针对新兴药物靶点的有前景新化合物先导物的更高效、更快速途径，从而能够预测一小部分分子用于进一步验证。这些组合方法节省了宝贵的时间和资源。由于甲氧西林耐药性，磺酰胺衍生物药物已被发现是治疗金黄色葡萄球菌感染的有效策略。当前研究采用基于配体的虚拟筛选（ligand-based virtual screening, LBVS），从抗菌化合物库中识别针对VraSR信号组分VraS和VraR的强效磺酰胺衍生物抑制剂。我们识别出有前景的磺酰胺衍生物[化合物5：(4-[(1-[(3,5-二甲氧基苯基)氨基甲酰基]甲基-2,4-二氧代-1,2,3,4-四氢喹唑啉-3-基)甲基]-N-[(呋喃-2-基)甲基]苯甲酰胺)]，其对传感器激酶VraS的ATP结合域具有合理的结合参数，为-31.38 kJ/mol，DeltaG(bind)评分为-294.32 kJ/mol。我们进一步识别出四种化合物N1（PCID83276726）、N3（PCID83276757）、N9（PCID3672584）和N10（PCID20900589），针对VraR DNA结合域（VraR(C)），其DeltaG(bind)能量分别为-190.27、-237.54、-165.21和-190.88 kJ/mol。结构和模拟分析进一步表明它们与DNA相互作用残基的稳定相互作用，以及破坏DNA结合域二聚化的潜力；因此，进一步研究和表征它们作为VraR二聚体破坏剂并抑制其他启动子结合位点是明智的。有趣的是，发现靶向VraS和VraR的药物可能为耐药性金黄色葡萄球菌开辟新的治疗途径。这些基于筛选、模拟和针对VraSR组分结合亲和力的预测，有望为对抗耐药性金黄色葡萄球菌开辟新的治疗途径，并为药物再利用工作提供机会。这些努力旨在创建具有增强效力和选择性的类似物，针对显著促进MRSA或VRSA毒力的双组分信号系统。这些分析为通过计算驱动的药物发现策略对抗抗生素耐药性金黄色葡萄球菌提供了宝贵的潜在途径见解。
